actions.body: Synthesis of recent literature indicates that while self-correction is a critical feature for autonomous agents, its implementation remains sparse and primarily experimental. Current frameworks rely heavily on confidence calibration and recursive verification loops to detect synthetic reasoning errors (source-bda2bc47c38c47a2, source-db145486024f469a). There is significant uncertainty regarding how these error-detection signals scale outside of synthetic, controlled reasoning tasks. Further research is required to determine the robustness of recursive verification in real-world, high-entropy environments.
actions.lede: Synthesizing recent literature on internal error detection and self-correction across major cognitive architectures.
